source: Puma et al. (2012), Third Grade Follow-up to the Head Start Impact Study: Final Report, OPRE 2012-45; rendered Exhibits 4.2 and 4.10 (printed pp. 78 and 91), with explanatory text on printed p. 83.
scope: One statistically significant-at-10%-threshold, parent-reported third-grade school-performance result for the 3-year-old cohort and its IOT counterpart. The pair is one outcome from the same randomized access study, not two studies.
